card.name: Linking words before hereditary tumor syndromes
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as in, with, of or called that come right before a hereditary tumor syndrome, mainly after medullary thyroid carcinoma (MTC) and before Multiple Endocrine Neoplasia or neurofibromatosis.

modes.label: Before MEN syndrome
modes.description: The words in or with after medullary thyroid carcinoma, just ahead of Multiple Endocrine Neoplasia.
modes.example: personal or family history of medullary thyroid carcinoma (MTC) or<< in>> patients with Multiple Endocrine Neoplas
